theorem checkedMerge_some_iff (I : Input q n k) (c d out : Body q n k) :
    checkedMerge I c d = some out ↔
      bodyCheck I c = true ∧ bodyCheck I d = true ∧ merge c d = out

theorem checkedMerge_valid {I : Input q n k} {c d out : Body q n k}
    (h : checkedMerge I c d = some out) : bodyCheck I out = true

theorem checkedLinkParent_some_iff (I : Input q n k) (c : Body q n k)
    (parent : Node q n k) (out : Body q n k) : checkedLinkParent I c parent = some out ↔
      bodyCheck I c = true ∧ parent.support ∉ bodySupports c ∧
      parent.Valid I c ∧ linkParent c parent = out

theorem checkedLinkParent_valid {I : Input q n k} {c out : Body q n k} {parent : Node q n k}
    (h : checkedLinkParent I c parent = some out) : bodyCheck I out = true

@[simp] theorem boundCheck_iff {q n k : ℕ} (actual : Input q n k) (package : BoundBody q n k)
    (B : Support q) (s : Fin n) : boundCheck actual package B s = true ↔
      actual = package.input ∧ check actual package.body B s = true

theorem boundCheck_stale {q n k : ℕ} {actual : Input q n k} {package : BoundBody q n k}
    (h : actual ≠ package.input) (B : Support q) (s : Fin n) : boundCheck actual package B s = false
